name: Pipedrive
description: Import your Pipedrive organisations and people into Organisations.

methods.whenToUse: Use the personal API token from your Pipedrive account.
methods.guidanceMd: Paste the personal API token of a Pipedrive user who can see every organisation and person you want to import. Find it in Pipedrive under Settings > Personal preferences > API. Importing only reads from Pipedrive; nothing is written back.
methods.label: Use a personal API token

credentialFields.label: Pipedrive API token
credentialFields.helperMd: In Pipedrive, open Settings > Personal preferences > API and copy Your personal API token.

tenantFields.label: Company domain
tenantFields.helperMd: Optional. The part before .pipedrive.com in your Pipedrive address, for example greatstone for greatstone.pipedrive.com.
